"### Chart Description: Real BCRA Liabilities

The provided chart is a line graph titled "**Real BCRA Liabilities**" with a subtitle indicating the data is indexed to **Jan 2022 = 100**. It tracks the value of these liabilities over time from February 2022 to April 2024.

*   **Y-axis:** Represents the index value, ranging from **50 to 130** in increments of 10.
*   **X-axis:** Represents time in months, with labels every two months from **2/1/2022 to 4/1/2024**.
